summary.whatChanges: Adds a prototype-backed `util.cachedInternal` lazy box (class with getter on the prototype) and switches object, JIT-object, and discriminated-union schema internals to it. Simplifies `util.cached` by dropping its unreachable "cached value already set" throw while keeping its own enumerable `value` shape. Adds tests covering both.
behaviorChanges: `z.core.util` gains a new exported `cachedInternal` helper returning a `{ value: T }` box whose `value` lives on the prototype (no own property, not enumerable, not spreadable)
`util.cached` no longer contains the unreachable branch that threw "cached value already set"; it still memoizes on first read as an own enumerable, configurable, non-writable property
Object, JIT-object, and discriminated-union schemas now allocate the lighter internal cache box for normalized defs and the discriminator map
Internal cache boxes expose `_getter`/`_value` fields and re-run the getter if the first invocation throws
risks: cachedInternal boxes have no own `value`, so any code that spreads, serializes, or enumerates them (e.g. Object.keys / JSON.stringify) silently loses the value
Assigning to `box.value` now throws TypeError in strict mode for the internal box since the prototype accessor has no setter
A getter that throws leaves the internal box unresolved and re-executes on the next read, allowing repeated side effects
Caching undefined works only because the getter reference is cleared; the `_value as T` cast hides type unsoundness
